title: Separable Nonnegative Matrix Factorization Using Powered Ratio-of-Norms Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2608.28799v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Separable nonnegative matrix factorization (SNMF) has been widely used for low-rank representation and clustering of nonnegative data, owing to its ability to produce part-based and interpretable decompositions. In particular, SNMF is closely related to graph clustering and community detection. To enhance sparsity and identifiability of the learned factors, we propose an $\ell_1^p/\ell_2$-regularized SNMF model based on a powered ratio-of-norms regularizer. The resulting formulation is nonconvex and nonsmooth, which poses significant challenges for optimization. To address this, we develop efficient algorithms based on the difference-of-convex function algorithm (DCA) and the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). The proposed methods decompose the original problem into tractable subproblems, leveraging closed-form proximal operators associated with the powered norm terms. translated_title: 基于幂次范数比正则化的可分离非负矩阵分解
translated_abstract: 可分离非负矩阵分解（SNMF）因其能够产生基于部分的、可解释的分解，已被广泛应用于非负数据的低秩表示和聚类。特别地，SNMF与图聚类和社区检测密切相关。为了增强所学习因子的稀疏性和可辨识性，我们提出了一种基于幂次范数比正则项的 ℓ₁ᵖ/ℓ₂ 正则化 SNMF 模型。所得的优化形式是非凸且非光滑的，这给求解带来了重大挑战。为解决这一问题，我们基于差凸函数算法（DCA）和交替方向乘子法（ADMM）开发了高效算法。所提出的方法将原问题分解为易于处理的子问题，并利用与幂次范数项相关的闭式邻近算子。我们建立了下降性和极限临界性等性质（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于幂次范数比正则化的 ℓ₁ᵖ/ℓ₂ 正则化可分离非负矩阵分解模型，并结合DCA与ADMM设计出利用闭式邻近算子的高效优化算法，从而增强了因子的稀疏性与可辨识性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an ℓ₁ᵖ/ℓ₂-regularized separable nonnegative matrix factorization model with a powered ratio-of-norms regularizer and develops efficient DCA- and ADMM-based algorithms leveraging closed-form proximal operators to enhance sparsity and identifiability of the learned factors.
